priorityList: Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the highest-health target.
Trinket Usage We generally want to use stat-granting on-use trinkets with Trueshot.
Cast Multi immediately after every Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire to spend Precise Shots stacks and activate Trick Shots.
Activate Trueshot right before we would normally intend to Cast Aimed Shot.
Cast Moonlight Chakram when you have fewer than 1.2 charges of Aimed Shot remaining, or if you have less than 35 Focus.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler.
Every single Precise Shots proc must be spent
Spend Precise Shots procs on Multi on 2+ targets
Follow up every Aimed Shot or Rapid Fire with a Multi
